data.title: Ramps Logistics CEO Joins Global Tariffs Panel at Breakbulk Americas 2026 as Trinidad-Developed AI Platform Returns
data.description: Trinidad and Tobago's Ramps Logistics CEO, Shaun Rampersad, will participate at Breakbulk Americas 2026 in Houston, the biggest event in the Americas. The event is scheduled for September 22–23 at the George R. Brown Convention Center. On September 23, Rampersad will join the discussion titled "Planning in the Fog: Risk, Tariffs, and the Cost of Resilience" on the Breakbulk Live Stage, where international trade and project cargo experts will share insights. It promises to be an engaging session focusing on crucial industry topics.

data.title: Disney appoints Karandeep Anand as its inaugural CTO, a move reflecting industry's trend towards A.I. integration.
data.description: A highly skilled individual, Karandeep Anand, renowned for his expertise in developing artificial intelligence and consumer technology products, has been appointed as Disney's inaugural chief technology officer. This marks a significant milestone for the company as Anand assumes the crucial role within Disney's tech leadership.

data.title: CFTC sends crypto market regulation plan to White House after Senate stalls CLARITY Act.
data.description: The US commodities regulator has proposed a fresh regulatory action for the cryptocurrency market, which is now under review by the White House. This development comes shortly after the Senate was unable to progress the CLARITY Act.
